newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy cabinet approves pension block for teachers.
newsitem.headline: Italy cabinet approves pension block for teachers.

text.p: The Italian cabinet on Friday approved a plan to stem the flood of teachers seeking retirement, cabinet sectretary Enrico Micheli told reporters.

He said only around half of the 65,000 teachers who have requested to go into retirement this year will be given the go-ahead. A block on early retirements could bring big savings for the cash-strapped Treasury.

Education Minister Luigi Berlinguer said some 33,000 teachers would be able to go into retirement from September 1, 1997. Retirement for the remaining 32,000 would be gradually phased in, he told reporters.
The minister said that if the government had not acted, the huge number of teachers seeking to quit the profession would have blown a four trillion lire hole in 1997 state accounts.
"The balance of public finances will not now be altered," he said. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
